observations: Photo 0 shows the front of the box for a 'Quest 1 Litre Deep Fat Fryer' with specifications: Voltage AC 220-240V/50Hz, Rated Power 900W, Cord Length 1.10m approx.

Photo 1 shows the actual deep fat fryer unit, white and black, with a visible UK-style 3-pin plug, placed on top of the box. The unit has a dial with temperature markings (80-190°C) and icons for different food types.
Photo 2 shows the front of the box again, highlighting features: Power 900W, Anti Slip Feet, Non-Stick Bowl, Adjustable Temperature.
The box and unit both show the 'Quest' brand logo.
The unit appears to be new and unused, with bubble wrap and packaging visible in photo 1.
The plug is a UK 3-pin type, which is not standard in Nigeria (Nigeria uses BS 546 or BS 1363 with different pin configurations).

claims.claim: A 1-liter deep fat fryer is a compact electric appliance for making single or two-person portions
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 2 show the box labeled '1 Litre Deep Fat Fryer', and the unit is small and compact in photo 1.
Photo 0 box shows 'Rated Power: 900W'. Photo 2 also lists 'Power: 900W'.
Photo 2 lists 'Non-Stick Bowl' as a feature, but the bowl is not visible in any photo. No shot shows the interior of the fryer.
Photo 2 lists 'Anti Slip Feet', but no photo shows the bottom of the unit to verify this feature.
Photo 1 shows a dial with temperature markings from 80°C to 190°C. Photo 2 lists 'Adjustable Temperature'.

risks.risk: The appliance has a UK 3-pin plug, which is incompatible with standard Nigerian power outlets without an adapter.
risks.proof: A photo of the plug inserted into a Nigerian socket or a photo showing the plug with a compatible adapter.
risks.if_unproven: priced as incompatible, requiring an adapter or rewiring, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The non-stick bowl may be damaged or not present, as it is not visible in any photo.
risks.proof: A photo showing the interior of the fryer bowl, confirming it is intact and non-stick.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially damaged or missing, reducing value.

risks.risk: The unit may not be functional, as there is no evidence of it being tested or powered on.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the unit plugged in and the dial turning, or a test of the heating element.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working, which is the worst case.

proof_requests: A photo of the fryer bowl interior to verify the non-stick coating and condition.
A photo of the bottom of the unit to verify anti-slip feet.
A video or photo showing the unit powered on and the dial functioning.
A photo of the UK plug with a Nigerian adapter or a note confirming the plug can be changed.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a Quest 1 Litre Deep Fat Fryer, but critical risks remain unproven: the plug is incompatible with Nigerian outlets, the non-stick bowl is not visible, and functionality is unverified. These risks must be resolved before pricing can be determined accurately.
